channel.title: D2 Item of the Day
channel.description: One rare Diablo 2 collector's item every day.

item.title: 1.08 Raven Frost
item.description:
1.08 Raven Frost
no dexterity at all

Rarity: Uncommon

Raven Frost is the dexterity ring. Fifteen to twenty dex, two hundred odd attack rating, forty mana, cold absorb, cannot be frozen. Take all of that away except the last line and this is what is left. In its place sit a frost nova that fires when you are struck and thirty five cold resist, neither of which the modern ring has. Plainly the worse ring, and the only Raven Frost that ever cast a spell.

item.title: Death's Guard + Death's Hand
item.description:
Death's Guard + Death's Hand
cannot-be-frozen combo

Rarity: Uncommon

Two cheap set pieces, a sash and a pair of gloves, both usable at level six. Worn together they give cannot be frozen, thirty percent attack speed, and eight percent life steal. Cannot be frozen with no real level requirement is the prize. It frees an amulet or ring slot a twink would otherwise spend on the same effect. The classic lesson in why junk-looking set pieces matter.

item.title: Grim Needle
item.description:
Grim Needle
the bow nobody has seen in years

Rarity: Mythic

The bow people still ask about. A rare Matriarchal Bow, self found and self upped from an Ashwood, socketed with two forty-fifteen jewels, the best jewels in the game. A bow skill, fifty attack speed, and an enhanced-damage number that reads like a typo, all under a yellow name. Its owner sold it to a private buyer off-site years ago and has not seen it since. Faith, the runeword everyone points to, is a newspawn's eyecandy next to it.

item.title: Doom Stalker
item.description:
Doom Stalker
rare leech boots

Rarity: Very Rare

The slot most players fill with a unique and forget. This rare does more. Thirty faster run and walk, forty lightning and forty fire, twenty life with a little replenish, and the part people forget boots can even roll: life steal. Speed, two big resists, life and leech in one slot almost never land together. The leech here is one percent. A perfect roll pushes it higher.

item.title: Spectral Shard
item.description:
Spectral Shard
Spec Shard

Rarity: Uncommon

The damage on it is a joke, four to fifteen, so a melee player tosses it. Casters know better. Fifty percent faster cast rate at a level twenty five requirement is a huge breakpoint for the price, and it comes with mana and resistances attached. In the low-level caster bracket it is a default pick, and outside that bracket nobody notices it exists.

item.title: Viper Casque
item.description:
Viper Casque
socketed rare helm

Rarity: Very Rare

A rare helm that quietly covers four needs at once. Twenty faster hit recovery, eighty eight life, two resistances, and an open socket, all on a Bone Helm a caster or hybrid can wear. No single line screams, which is why it gets scrolled past, but the sum holds its own against the uniques in the slot, and the socket lets you tune it further.

item.title: 1.08 Arreat's Face
item.description:
1.08 Arreat's Face
target defense, not resistances

Rarity: Very Rare

The Arreat's Face people know is defensive. Thirty to all resistances, twenty strength, twenty dexterity, life steal, a hundred and fifty enhanced defense. This one is an attacking helm wearing the same name. It cuts fifteen percent off the target's defense and adds maximum damage that climbs half a point per level, reaching forty nine at the cap. A barbarian helm that helps you hit rather than survive.
